ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Mstsc.EXE Execution With Local RDP File
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential RDP connection via Mstsc using a local ".rdp" file located in suspicious locations.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\mstsc\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "mstsc\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\\.rdp$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.rdp\\$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\spool\\\\drivers\\\\color.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Tasks\\_Migrated\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tracing\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*")))
